title: RBAC v2 incremental evaluator with session-aware scoping and enriched audit stream
creator: Aisha Navarro
description: Implement a new incremental policy evaluator that performs session-aware token scoping and emits an enriched audit stream for API/runtime/console traffic. The goal is to reduce authorization latency for high-throughput routes by applying change-based evaluation (only evaluate policy nodes affected by the request/session delta) while preserving deterministic, auditable decisions for compliance. The evaluator must integrate with existing auth middleware in the runtime and the Console React auth layer, support SSO/SAML-derived attributes (groups, role assertions), and attach an immutable audit envelope that includes policy version, evaluation trace id, decision rationale (human-readable), and any fallback path taken.
acceptance_criteria: Evaluator returns identical allow/deny results compared to canonical full-eval for 1000 sample prompts across models
P95 authorization latency reduction by >=40% on /v1/generate and console metadata endpoints under baseline synthetic load
Audit messages produced for each authorization event include: actor, session_id, token_scope, policy_version, trace_id, decision, reason_snippet, and fallback_info
Rollout plan: canary to 5% of hosted API traffic then 25% then 100% with automatic rollback on regression of authorization errors >0.1% or auth latency increase >15%
Security review completed and sign-off from Security and Compliance teams
technical_notes: Design uses a directed dependency graph of policy clauses and attributes. On each request we compute session delta (attributes changed since last evaluation) and walk only affected subgraph. Store lightweight evaluation cache keyed by session_id + policy_hash + attribute_version. For SSO/SAML attributes, normalize group assertions into stable ids and preload into attribute cache during session establishment. Audit enrichment is implemented as a sidecar writer that atomically attaches trace_id to both runtime logs and the audit Kafka topic. We will add feature flags: rbac_v2_incremental_eval and rbac_v2_audit_enrich. Compatibility: default to full-eval if any cache miss or if session is unauthenticated.
rollout_plan: 1) Feature flag gated behind 'rbac_v2_incremental_eval' and 'rbac_v2_audit_enrich'. 2) Nightly internal canary (internal accounts) for 48h. 3) 5% external canary for 24h with increased tracing. 4) 25% canary for 48h with canary dashboards. 5) Full rollout. Monitoring: auth_error_rate, auth_latency_p50/p95, audit_sink_lag, canary_fallback_count. Automated rollback triggers defined in runbook.
